Definition: from G3372; to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge:--grow up.
BiblicalUsage: Mekyno means to lengthen, to grow up, and its one appearance is in the parable of the seed. Mark 4:27 says the seed should spring and grow up, night and day, while the sower sleeps and rises and knows not how.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe growth in God's kingdom is His work more than ours: we sow, and He lengthens what we cannot explain.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Growing Seed
